messages:
maria: Quick ask — for the cost-modeling run we need a canonical set of inputs to ask hardware partners. Specifically: per-SKU supply windows (UTC ranges), reserved commitment tiers (units + tenor), spot/preemptible block size distribution and eviction cadence, and billing lag (days to invoice). Any thoughts on required fields?

alex (finance): From finance: please include effective unit price (USD/hr), reserved discount %, min commit tenor (months), early termination penalty (USD or %), invoice lag days, and an estimate of spot price variance (std dev or pct).

kevin (eng): For the simulator we also want: typical block durations (mean, p50, p90), mean time between evictions, and common block sizes (e.g., 4x A100, 16x A10). Also a mapping column so 'unit' -> GPU spec (gpu_type, vram_gb, flop).

olivia (partnerships): Add marketplace-specific fields: listing_fee_pct, lead_time_days (time from PO to availability), and whether SKUs are region-locked. Vendors sometimes return commit as "slots" not GPUs — we need a normalization table.

jackson (pricing): Agree. Also ask for ramp constraints: max ramp-up rate (units/week) and max burst (units) so cost model can simulate slow onramps.

maria: Nice. Putting together a suggested CSV header here so outreach is consistent. Feedback welcome, then jackson and I will send to partners.

maria: ```csv
partner_name,partner_sku,unit_id,gpu_type,gpu_count,vram_gb,unit_price_usd_per_hour,reserved_discount_pct,min_commit_tenor_months,early_termination_fee_usd,invoice_lag_days,availability_window_utc,start_date,end_date,region,is_preemptible,mean_block_duration_minutes,p50_block_duration_minutes,p90_block_duration_minutes,mean_time_between_evictions_minutes,backfill_probability,max_ramp_units_per_week,max_burst_units,listing_fee_pct,lead_time_days,region_locked,notes
```

kevin (eng): Love the headers. Two small asks: add "unit_cpu_equiv" and "fp_precision_supported" (fp32/fp16/int8) so we can choose quantized variants for cost sims. Also add "historical_spot_rate_stddev" if they can provide.

olivia (partnerships): I'll include a short explanation doc with the CSV to avoid back-and-forth. Suggest we mark required vs optional columns. Required: partner_name, partner_sku, unit_price_usd_per_hour, is_preemptible, availability_window_utc, invoice_lag_days, gpu_type, gpu_count. Optional: block duration percentiles, ramp values.

jackson (pricing): I'll own vendor outreach and consolidation. Plan: send to top 12 partners, aim to close responses in 7 business days. Can someone review the email before I send?

maria: I'll review. olivia — can you attach the example email and the CSV template to the thread so we can iterate?

olivia (partnerships): Yep — drafting now, will paste into this thread in a follow-up.

sre-bot: Reminder: please avoid sending PII in attachments; redact contact emails.

maria: Great. After we collect responses, we'll run a sensitivity sweep (spot vs reserved mix, billing lag scenarios) and share a summary with product & ops. Thanks all :rocket:
